derivation: of Hebrew origin (H03063 or perhaps H03194);
def: Judah (i.e. Jehudah or Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine

occurrences.text: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
